option_relations.rationale: Ventricular tachyarrhythmia is a distinct cardiac rhythm disorder and not directly related to high-grade AV block.
Advanced conduction system disease is a broader category that includes high-grade AV block as a potential manifestation or progression.
Complete heart block (trifascicular block) is a severe form of atrioventricular block, which falls under the umbrella of high-grade AV block.
Masquerading bundle-branch block (MBBB) with progression to advanced atrioventricular block describes a specific scenario that can lead to or be considered a form of high-grade AV block.
